# Definition
Let $\mathbf{u}, \mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w} \in \mathbb{R}^3$. Then the ***scalar triple product*** of $\mathbf{u}, \mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w}$ is defined as

$$
\langle \mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w} \rangle
$$

## Proposition
Let $\mathbf{u}, \mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w} \in \mathbb{R}^3$.

**(i)** $\langle \mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w} \rangle = \langle \mathbf{u}, \mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{w} \rangle$.

**(ii)** $\displaystyle \langle \mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w} \rangle = \det \begin{bmatrix} u_1 & u_2 & u_3 \\ v_1 & v_2 & v_3 \\ w_1 & w_2 & w_3 \end{bmatrix}$.

**(iii)** The scalar triple product of $\mathbf{u}, \mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w}$ is the ***volume of the parallelepiped*** generated by $\mathbf{u}, \mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w}$.

### Proof

**(ii)**

$$\begin{align*}
\langle \mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w} \rangle &= \left \langle (\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v})_1, (\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v})_2, (\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v})_3, (w_1, w_2, w_3) \right \rangle \\
&= w_1 \det \begin{bmatrix} u_2 & u_3 \\ v_2 & v_3 \end{bmatrix} - w_2 \det \begin{bmatrix} u_1 & u_3 \\ v_1 & v_3 \end{bmatrix} + w_3 \det \begin{bmatrix} u_1 & u_2 \\ v_1 & v_2 \end{bmatrix} \\
&= \det \begin{bmatrix} w_1 & w_2 & w_3 \\ u_1 & u_2 & u_3 \\ v_1 & v_2 & v_3 \end{bmatrix} \\
&= \det \begin{bmatrix} u_1 & u_2 & u_3 \\ v_1 & v_2 & v_3 \\ w_1 & w_2 & w_3 \end{bmatrix}. \blacksquare
\end{align*}$$

# Reference
- R. S. Millman and G. D. Parker, Elements of Differential Geometry, Prentice-Hall, 1977.
